name: NCS 24th Annual Meeting
description: The Neurocritical Care Society holds its 24th annual meeting in Seattle, Washington, for physicians, nurses, advanced practice providers, pharmacists and trainees in neurocritical care. The program includes late breaking science and research abstract presentations under the theme Reaching New Heights.

name: NCS 25th Annual Meeting
description: The Neurocritical Care Society holds its 25th annual meeting in New Orleans, Louisiana, at the Hyatt Regency New Orleans. The meeting covers multidisciplinary neurocritical care research and clinical practice.

sources.note: Confirms dates September 27-30, 2027, and Hyatt Regency New Orleans venue.
